verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an API-driven generation platform, so the axis applies. The API guide says none of the 239 documented pages mention a sandbox, trial, or test environment, and the quickstart runs purchase-first against the production Singapore endpoint. A free tier for 'casual evaluation' is a pricing plan, not an isolated sandbox, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
